protocol_name: Cycle24 Validation Model and Threshold Selection Protocol
scientific_role: Select exactly one frozen candidate and one frozen probability threshold independently within each primary model family using only the Cycle24 validation partition.

selection_scope.reason: All three primary model families are retained for later predictive and SHAP cross-cycle stability analysis.

threshold_protocol.candidate_threshold_set: All unique predicted probabilities on Cycle24 validation for that frozen candidate, plus one all-negative sentinel threshold immediately above the maximum predicted probability.
threshold_protocol.exact_threshold_tie_break: If multiple thresholds produce exactly the same maximum TSS, select the highest threshold as a deterministic tie break.

validation_metrics.note: Diagnostic metrics may be reported but must not override the pre-registered family-specific selection hierarchy.

random_forest.note: max_depth=None is treated as unbounded and therefore ranks after numeric depths 12 and 24 when a complexity tie-break is required.

post_selection_rule.winner_model_artifact: Use the already-frozen TRAIN-only model artifact. Do not refit on TRAIN+VALIDATION.
post_selection_rule.winner_threshold: Freeze the Cycle24-validation-selected threshold and apply it unchanged to Cycle24 holdout and Cycle25.

holdout_policy.role: Independent Cycle24 performance estimate after all model and threshold development decisions are frozen.

cycle25_policy.role: Temporal cross-cycle test only; never used for tuning, threshold selection, feature selection, or preprocessing fit.

interpretation_constraints: Validation-selected thresholds are operating points, not intrinsic physical flare-probability boundaries.
SHAP values later describe model attribution and must not be interpreted as causal solar physics.
Predictive stability and explanation stability will be evaluated separately.
immutability_rule: After this protocol is frozen and before viewing validation outcomes, the threshold-search method, selection metrics, family-specific tie-break rules, candidate sets, preprocessing, and model artifacts must not be changed in response to validation, holdout, or Cycle25 results.
